title: GhostClaw provider model registry
description:
Shape of config/models.<lane>.json for every provider lane (maxplus, cointh, …).

Every record must come from a live probe. An id transcribed from a config file, a screenshot, or a vendor page is not admissible — the cointh probe found two of four declared ids had the wrong casing, and the maxplus probe found three listed ids that were not routable at all.

Decision records: docs/decisions/P098-RevD.md (maxplus), P098-RevF.md (cointh).

lane.description: Lane name. Must match the filename: config/models.<lane>.json

decision.description: Governing decision record and its status, e.g. 'P098 Rev D (APPROVED 2026-07-25)'.

tier.description: PRIMARY = first choice for its model family. LEAF = fallback only; the system must keep working without it.

risk_ceiling.description: Highest risk tier this lane may execute. No lane may be 'red' — RED advances only through the structural HIGH gate.

base_url.description: HTTPS origin, optionally with a path prefix (cointh serves at /glm/anthropic). Must NOT end in a slash or in /v1: clients append /v1/messages themselves, and a /v1 suffix produces /v1/v1/messages.

pool.description: Live pool identifier, 'n/a' for single-vendor gateways, or 'VERIFY AT RUN TIME' when the provider exposes none.

id.description: Model id byte-for-byte as returned by the live list. Casing is significant.

status.description: OK = 200 with non-empty content. EMPTY = 200 but still empty after the single retry at 4096 tokens. ERR = non-2xx on every schema probed. ABSENT = advertised somewhere but not in the live list.

needs_big_budget.description: True when the model returned 200 with empty content at a small max_tokens and recovered at 4096.
